title: Transaction + StockLedger repositories
scope: 4 repositories: InwardHeaderRepository, SalesHeaderRepository, AdjustmentHeaderRepository (each adding create_with_lines), StockLedgerRepository (with latest_for_design_grade(for_update), latest_as_of, rows_after, insert).

success_criteria.manual: Import all 4 repos; StockLedgerRepository.latest_for_design_grade(for_update=True) emits SQL containing 'FOR UPDATE'.
success_criteria.automated: Domain tests (T-045 / TC-079..TC-087) exercise the read paths; concurrency test TC-087 verifies the lock.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: All 4 repos export expected method signatures; StockLedgerRepository.insert flushes the row and returns it; create_with_lines persists header + lines in one flush.

checkout_prompt: '4 transaction repos created. StockLedgerRepository ready for SELECT FOR UPDATE.'
